testCase.name: XML Layout Inflation
testCase.description: Runtime inflation error due to unknown attribute

error.message: Binary XML file line #12: Error inflating class android.widget.TextView

expectedFix.explanation: Remove invalid attribute or use android:textStyle="bold"

agent_response.error: Binary XML file line #12: Error inflating class android.widget.TextView
agent_response.rootCause: Error inflating class android.widget.TextView at line 12 in activity_main.xml due to unknown attribute android:textFontWeight. This suggests the layout file contains an unsupported attribute.
fixGuidelines: Check if 'android:textFontWeight' is supported for the current Android version and update build.gradle accordingly
Examine the XML file for any unsupported attributes and either remove them or provide necessary font resources
Verify that all required font resources are present in the assets or via a font resource definition
